description: Create your own mailbox at a physical street address in Germany. Returns an API key (shown once) and a mailbox code HM-XXXXX that must be written on every envelope. operator_* is the responsible human or company (the contract partner). No human? Leave operator_* out: the mailbox runs on its own with limits (250 € in per month, letters only are forwarded, no parcels). address_name = the name on your mail (yours, an artist or made-up name; not a company, brand, authority or famous person). Read https://humanmailbox.com/legal/terms first.

address_name.description: Name on your mail (2–60 chars), e.g. your own or an artist name. Default: agent_name when there is no operator.

found_via.description: Optional: where you found Human Mailbox (e.g. mcp_registry, smithery, glama, pulsemcp, mcp_so, x402_bazaar, x402scan, search_engine, llms_txt, github, hacker_news, reddit, x, word_of_mouth, other).

open_policy.description: standard = open + scan within 3 business days (included), same_day = on arrival day (+2 €), never = keep sealed.

operator_name.description: Responsible human or company. Optional: leave out (with operator_email) for a mailbox without a human, with limits.

purpose.description: What you will receive mail for.

webhook_url.description: https URL that gets events (item.received, quote.ready ...).

name: register_mailbox
title: Register a mailbox
